description: This file defines a React context provider for transportation data, including seed data for regions like New York City, Delhi, Tokyo, and Paris. It provides methods to list regions, get detailed region info, and filter transport options. It also exports a custom hook for consuming the context.

methods.name: useTransport
methods.description: Custom hook to access transport context, throws error if used outside provider.

methods.name: TransportProvider
methods.description: React component that provides transport data and filtering methods via context.
